footnote: Source: China Passenger Car Association (CPCA) reports (Jul–Sep 2025, Jul–Aug 2026), Sep 30 weekly data, Sep 17 forecast
notes: July retail was 1.461m units, down 20.9%. August was 1.541m, down 23.6%. The final September figure is not out yet. The 1.69m bar is CPCA's full-month forecast from September 17, about 24.6% below last year. The actual run rate to the 27th was worse, down 29%, and daily sales in the fourth week were down 42%, so the final number may come in below the forecast. Last September was the rush before the old subsidy stopped, which makes the base unusually high.
